primary_claim: Answer Matching -- grading free-form generative responses against a ground-truth reference using a small LM matcher -- achieves near-perfect alignment with ground-truth verification, dramatically outperforming multiple-choice (MCQ) evaluation, which can be solved via discriminative choice-only shortcuts (even without the question or image) and is poorly aligned with ground-truth correctness.

effect.value: 0.98 (Answer Matching, small 4B matcher) vs 0.72 (LLM-as-judge without reference, DeepSeek V3)

contradicts_or_qualifies: Prior attempts at fixing MCQ choice-only shortcuts, GoldenSwag (for HellaSwag) and TruthfulQA v2, ended up worsening the problem
stated_future_work: Focus effort on creating questions designed for answer matching, similar to SimpleQA, GAIA, and parts of HLE
Make questions specific enough to have a single semantic answer, or list the multiple correct solutions that are possible
limitations_stated: Grading generative responses outside verifiable domains like code and math is inherently challenging because many paraphrases can be valid answers
quote: Answer Matching outcomes give near-perfect alignment, with even small (recent) models like Qwen3-4B.
